description:
Sedona Digital is a technology consulting and services company specialising in AI, Data, Security, Business Applications and Software Engineering. We help organisations solve complex business and technology challenges, from strategy and solution design through to implementation and ongoing delivery. 

Our teams combine deep technical expertise with a practical, outcome-focused approach, working with clients through consulting, project delivery, capability augmentation and managed teams. We are focused on helping organisations modernise their technology, unlock value from their data, adopt AI safely and build the capabilities they need for the future. 

The Role

Sedona Digital is looking for a Business Analysts to support discovery, requirements definition, process and data analysis, testing and implementation for Finance / FP&A data products. You will work under the direction of the Data Product Manager and Senior Business Analyst while independently owning allocated analysis work packages. 

Key Responsibilities
  • Elicit, document and validate business and user requirements. 
  • Facilitate workshops, interviews and playback sessions with subject-matter experts. 
  • Produce user stories, process maps, data flows, business rules and acceptance criteria. 
  • Maintain requirements traceability and support backlog refinement. 
  • Analyse source-to-target requirements, data definitions, quality rules and reconciliation needs. 
  • Support options analysis, impact assessment and dependency identification. 
  • Prepare UAT scenarios, support testing and assist with defect clarification. 
  • Maintain clear documentation, action tracking and decision logs. 
  • Work collaboratively across Finance, Data Engineering, Oracle, Workday and supplier teams. 
  • Gather, document and validate business requirements and user stories.
  • Develop and maintain process maps, data flows, business rules and data definitions.
  • Maintain requirements traceability and document key business decisions.
  • Define UAT scenarios and support defect clarification and resolution.
  • Produce clear, handover-ready analysis documentation for relevant stakeholders.
What You Bring
  • Proven Business Analyst experience in technology, data or business-change delivery. 
  • Strong requirements elicitation, process modelling, user-story and acceptance-criteria capability. 
  • Ability to work independently on defined work packages. 
  • Good facilitation, stakeholder engagement and written communication. 
  • Experience supporting testing, defect resolution and implementation readiness. 
  • Ability to work across cross-functional and supplier teams. 
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, Visio, Miro or equivalent tools. 
  • Insurance or financial-services experience. 
  • Experience of Finance, FP&A, workforce, FTE, cost, GL or financial-planning data. 
  • Experience involving Oracle and/or Workday. 
  • Experience delivering on GCP/BigQuery or a comparable cloud data platform. 
Why Join Sedona Digital?

Our values of Integrity, Persistence, and Impact guide everything we do. Join us in shaping the future while making a meaningful difference for our clients and team.
